summary: Implementation plan to resolve the GitHub Actions '4 tests completed, 1 failed' error in :app:testDebugUnitTest by upgrading the CI runtime to JDK 21 (required by Gradle 9.3.1, AGP 9.1.1, and Robolectric 4.16.1 Android SDK 36 bytecode), configuring JVM module opens and headless flags for Robolectric, and enabling FULL stack trace logging plus GitHub Actions Step Summary reporting.
